messages:
zoe-cs: Heads-up folks — PearlMart has an EU onboarding demo next week 08:00 UTC. They want a temporary provisioning window and a header-based allowlist so their CDN can sign requests. This demo influences a renewal decision in ~12 days, product flagged some churn risk if latency or auth issues show up.

matt-ops: Can you confirm spike size, window, region preference, and whether they also want IP allowlisting?

zoe-cs: Product asks for +2.5x baseline QPS for 5 hours (2026-06-20T08:00Z -> 2026-06-20T13:00Z). Primary region eu-central-1. Fallback to eu-west-1 only if capacity constrained. They want header X-Pearl-Key with values like pearl_live_XXXXXX (6-10 alnum). Also requested a CIDR allowlist for their accelerator: 198.51.100.0/24. Auto-revoke after the window. Tag account renewal_status=watch.

sana-eng: We can do header pattern ^pearl_live_[A-Za-z0-9]{6,10}$. Gateway can enforce both header and source CIDR together (header OR CIDR allowed). For graceful degradation we have a compact model pearl-lite-q3_1 that trades latency for slightly lower output quality. I recommend a fallback when p99_latency > 450ms for 90s or if 5xx rate > 1.5% sustained for 2m. Also suggest enabling a soft reserved pool bump (ephemeral) so noisy neighbours don't starve them.

matt-ops: Drafting change request with auto-revoke, header+cidr allow, regional routing, rate multiplier, fallback conditions, and ephemeral pool bump. Any alert thresholds?

zoe-cs: Alerts please: p95 > 300ms OR error_rate > 1% during window. Capture sample request ids and any auth failures. Kayla (AM) wants a post-demo checkin — mark renewal_watch and notify AMs immediately if any errors.

matt-ops: CR snippet ready:```json
{
  "customer": "pearlmart-retail",
  "change_request": "CR-2026-0812-pearl-eu-onboard",
  "window_start": "2026-06-20T08:00:00Z",
  "duration": "5h",
  "rate_multiplier": "2.5",
  "region_policy": {"preferred": ["eu-central-1"], "fallback": ["eu-west-1"]},
  "allowlist": {"header": "X-Pearl-Key", "pattern": "^pearl_live_[A-Za-z0-9]{6,10}$", "cidr": "198.51.100.0/24"},
  "ephemeral_pool": "small-burst-bump",
  "fallback_model": "pearl-lite-q3_1",
  "fallback_condition": "p99_latency > 450ms for 90s OR 5xx_rate > 1.5% for 2m",
  "alerts": "p95>300ms OR error_rate>1%",
  "auto_revoke": true
}
``` 

sana-eng: LGTM. I'll stage the fallback model and add the routing policy to prefer eu-central-1. Matt: please include runbook steps for rollback to avoid accidental long-lived bumps.

matt-ops: Change request CR-2026-0812-pearl-eu-onboard created and pushed to infra. Attaching runbook and auto-revoke timer.

infra-bot: Change CR-2026-0812-pearl-eu-onboard applied: rate_multiplier=2.5 (eu-central-1 preferred), header allowlist for X-Pearl-Key added, CIDR 198.51.100.0/24 added, ephemeral_pool small-burst-bump allocated, fallback enabled to pearl-lite-q3_1 with configured conditions. Alerts configured. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2026-06-20T13:00:00Z.

kayla-am: Noted  I'll tag account renewal_watch and schedule a 1:1 follow up within 48h post-demo. Zoe please collect sample traces, any 401s/403s, and a short customer quote about performance.

zoe-cs: Will collect logs, sample traces, and customer diary. Will post a concise summary in this thread within 24h after the window. :memo:
